title: koeleria cristata var. grandiflora
intro: Koeleria cristata var. grandiflora, commonly known as Big Junegrass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. The Big Junegrass has been found to have various health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent and an antioxidant, which can help to reduce oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria cristata var. grandiflora include its potential to act as an anti-anxiety agent and its ability to help lower blood pressure due to its vasodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Koeleria cristata var. grandiflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
